name: Situation Ventes Huilerie
query: SELECT v.date_vente AS `Date:Date:100`, v.name AS `Vente:Link/Vente Huilerie:180`, v.client AS `Client:Link/Customer:180`, v.total_ht AS `Montant:Currency:130`, COALESCE(si.outstanding_amount,0) AS `Reste:Currency:130`, v.statut AS `Statut:Data:130` FROM `tabVente Huilerie` v LEFT JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON si.name=v.facture_vente WHERE v.docstatus=1 ORDER BY v.date_vente DESC
